name: Trick Treat Test!
source:
Let's 'test' some special selection of kids' toys with the factory's somewhat... peculiar owner! 
A few deaths would merely be a pinch of sour to take the sweet success.

This game is a point-and-click where you progress the story by interacting with toys provided by the factory owner.

There are 22 endings, and most of them involve you dying! But don't worry—you'll come back to life. And by repeating the process, you might just uncover some secrets!

[From [url=https://arrokoth486958.itch.io/trick-treat-test]Itch.io[/url]]
